# Chiamaka Nwachukwu
Blackpool  |  (07700) 900400  |  chiamakanwachukwu@hotmail.co.uk

## Personal statement
Organised paralegal with experience in residential conveyancing. Happy to relocate.

## Employment history
### Office Manager - Crown plc, Canterbury
*Nov 2022 – Present*
- Managed diaries and billing for three partners.
- Prepared completion statements and SDLT returns.
- Handled a caseload of 34 conveyancing files from instruction to completion.
- Ran ID and AML checks under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.
### Compliance Officer - Redbrick Whitecross & Co Ltd, Croydon
*Jul 2020 to Oct 2022*
- Prepared completion statements and SDLT returns.
- Handled a caseload of 90 conveyancing files from instruction to completion.
- Ran ID and AML checks under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.
- Managed diaries and billing for three partners.
### Conveyancing Assistant - Redbrick Evergreen LLP, Slough
*Apr 2018 to Jun 2020*
- Ran ID and AML checks under the Money Laundering Regulations 2017.
- Handled a caseload of 70 conveyancing files from instruction to completion.
- Prepared completion statements and SDLT returns.
- Managed diaries and billing for three partners.
### Paralegal - GSK, Worcester
*Aug 2015 - Mar 2018*
- Ran ID and AML checks under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.
- Prepared completion statements and SDLT returns.
- Managed diaries and billing for three partners.

## Education
BA (Hons) English, Sheffield Hallam University, 2016-2019

## Skills
Power BI, Xero, Python, Fluent Ukrainian

Supervisor, Harbour Beacon Limited
anidonaill@harbourbeaconlimited.co.uk
